question: On the shipped 0.15.0 build, with six fresh worlds, does the cap-112 allocation satisfy the full-window floor-plus-backfill law and does every measured rank-21-40 transition enter service, with allocation and band service able to fail independently?

program.question: Q054
program.relationship: BAND-1 was VOID on exact-56; BAND-2/3 corrected the floor; BAND-4 specified the full-window allocation-law B5 but was never granted or run. BAND-5 is the runnable block: a fresh seed set, the same allocation law, a dated grant before any cell, and a per-edge result.

reconciliation.backfill: The engine fills the remaining 56 seats with cooccurrences, then backfills unused cooccurrence seats with further transitions. A full window therefore has transitions + cooccurrences = 112.
reconciliation.observed_64_69: BAND-1 observed 64-69 transitions; those are 56 plus backfill, with 48-43 cooccurrences. 64-69 is not an acceptance threshold.
reconciliation.rule: Defensible B5: at least one full 112-row window; every full window has transitions >= 56, cooccurrences <= 56 and the sum 112; every allocation row sums to its window; the maximum served transition rank is above 40; every served edge parses and every served transition is ranked.

design.world: the PHASE_ACQUISITION compositional world at 120 cycles
design.pairing: each seed's world and stimulus are identical at both caps
design.freshness: Six fresh seeds; seed_collisions is empty at freeze time.
design.reuse: No prior block's cells, named band or result is reused.

band.definition: For each seed, every present transition at minimum cap-112 block rank 21-40; measured from the 112 universe and not filtered by cap-40 service.
band.zero_band: A zero band is a zero denominator and makes the block VOID.

gates.B1_build: one shipped 0.15.0 build across all cells; only MAX_PREDICTIONS differs
gates.B2_world: each seed has the same world digest and present fingerprint at both caps
gates.B3_band_identity: each band edge is a present transition at rank 21-40 with a recorded rank
gates.B4_control_40: cap 40 serves no band edge and its full 40-row windows sum with a 20-transition floor
gates.B5_allocation_law: cap 112 full windows satisfy transitions + cooccurrences = 112, transitions >= 56, cooccurrences <= 56, with rank and parsing live
gates.B6_denominator: every seed has a non-empty band and every band edge reaches the ledger
gates.B7_determinism: a fresh-process rerun of seed 20612601 at 112 reproduces its ledger
gates.B8_seed_axis: at least three distinct served-band sets across the six seeds

acceptance.criterion_b: every band edge is served at 112 and none at 40, with a live seed axis.
acceptance.confirmed: CONFIRMED only when both criteria pass.
acceptance.independent_failure: Perfect band service cannot rescue a failed B5; a perfect allocation cannot rescue an unserved band edge.
acceptance.not_fitted: 64-69 is not used as a threshold.

authorisation.quote: Register a new band block with a defensible B5 allocation rule and a fresh dated grant, then run its twelve cells into a per-edge result.
authorisation.note: Granted before the arm was built or any cell opened.

runner.why: the record and grant precede the arm

not_evidence: A preregistration until the cells run; after the run it reads allocation and band service on this world family, not capability, retention or transfer.

amendments.note: Grant recorded before the arm or any cell.
12 design cells plus the determinism rerun completed; per-edge result written.

B4 was corrected before acceptance: the cap-40 arm is the no-band-service control, not a second allocation law; early windows may have fewer than 20 transitions and more than 20 cooccurrences. No cell was re-run and no gate was rescored.

decision_table.condition: B1, B2, B3 identity, B6, B7 or B8 fails
decision_table.reading: the block is non-reproducible and the failed gate names what did not happen
decision_table.decision: record VOID; fix the failed gate and register a new block; read no acceptance

decision_table.reading: band service cannot establish the full-window floor-plus-backfill allocation
decision_table.decision: report the allocation failure; fix the allocation rule before another band block; no band confirmation

decision_table.condition: B5 passes and no measured band edge is served at 112
decision_table.reading: the allocation is correct but the measured rank-21-40 band does not enter service
decision_table.decision: report the refutation; the next step is the admission rule, not another cap level

decision_table.condition: B5 passes and some but not all measured band edges are served at 112
decision_table.reading: the allocation is correct but the band does not enter service uniformly
decision_table.decision: report the per-edge misses; the next step is the admission rule

decision_table.condition: B5 and every measured band edge pass, with the 40 control and seed axis live
decision_table.reading: the floor-plus-backfill law and fresh-world rank-21-40 service both hold
decision_table.decision: record the confirmation; the owner decides any engine or promotion step; no capability claim
